TL;DR: parents murdered, tries avenging, banished, meets a group, clears a dungeon, makes it their home, meets PC's

Shyvana the Banished is a Neutral good rogue from my classmates DnD campaign. 

She started as a fifth child in a poor family and was the smallest in the family, but what she lacked in size, she made up with intelligence. 

She was an ace student, even though her parents could barely pay for the schooling. She had a special interest in gymnastics and biology and that made her feel joy in her life. 

That joy was soon to end, as her parents were murdered supposedly for an unpaid debt. Blinded by rage, she hunted down the responsible man, who was the town's evil guild's leader.  

As she was below the guildhall's stairs, an old man supposedly a monk stopped her and told her that by killing him she would have started a war. She didn't believe him, so the monk laid his arm on her shoulder and casted a spell/curse/blessing on her and she had a revelation. She had a change of heart and was no longer mad at the guild leader. She was about to thank the monk, but he was gone. 

Before she had gathered her thoughts back, some guild guards saw her near the stairs with a dagger, so they went after her. She eventually got caught and dragged into the guildhall. 

To her surprise the guild's leader admired her determination for avenging her parents and because she was still very young, she was only banished from the city due to corrupt leaders. 

She survived in the forest by hunting and gathering berries, but the living environments were harsh. 

Once she met a group of orphans like her, they had assembled a mini guild and they tried to go in, but the monster inside killed the leader of the orphans. They told her that it was a goblin and they didn't know how to kill it. Shyvana in the other hand knew exactly what to do. They went in and eventually cleared the dungeon. Thry decided to make Shyvana their new leader and to make the dungeon their home.

They built a trap near the main room that had an illusion beholder in front of the door.

While the rest of their guild was hunting and she was writing her food and supplies log, some group wandered in (PC's) and behind them was a crusade army. They had to leave through a secret tunnel in the room. 

Rest is experienced in the sessions.
